title: Mothership at Langley incursion per Chris Mellon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Mothership at Langley incursion per Chris Mellon, about 2023 at Langley AFB, Hampton, Virginia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Chris Melon, former deputy assistant secretary of defense for intelligence under both Clinton and Bush. Yeah. Uh said that there was this mothership dynamic going on with the Hampton Air Force Base incursion as well where you have these little saucers flying out of a mother ship.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays what Chris Mellon, a former senior Pentagon intelligence official under Presidents Clinton and Bush, has said about unknown objects flying over Langley Air Force Base in Hampton, Virginia, in 2023. According to Michels, Mellon said there was a mothership pattern, with small saucers flying out of a larger craft. If true, it would mean a coordinated group of unknown craft entered a US military base's airspace.
